title: Renting a Car in a New Country
paragraphs: Sebelum perjalanan kerjanya ke negara tetangga, Yasir belum pernah mengemudi di sisi jalan yang berlawanan, dan ia merasa gugup saat menandatangani berkas di loket penyewaan mobil. Petugas menyadari kegugupannya dan dengan sabar menjelaskan perbedaannya: posisi kemudi, rambu lalu lintas, dan beberapa kebiasaan berkendara setempat yang perlu ia ingat.

Sepuluh menit pertama di jalan terasa benar-benar tidak nyaman, dan Yasir memegang kemudi dengan erat di setiap bundaran, tapi ia perlahan mulai rileks seiring pola yang asing itu terasa lebih alami. Menjelang akhir minggu, mengemudi tidak lagi terasa aneh sama sekali. Yasir menyadari bahwa sebagian besar ketakutan tentang melakukan hal yang tidak familiar cepat memudar begitu seseorang benar-benar mencobanya.
answerKey: Before his work trip to a neighboring country, Yasir had never driven on the opposite side of the road, and he felt nervous as he signed the paperwork at the rental car counter. The staff member noticed his hesitation and patiently walked him through the differences: the position of the wheel, the traffic signs, and a few local driving customs he would need to remember. The first ten minutes on the road felt genuinely uncomfortable, and Yasir gripped the wheel tightly at every roundabout, but he gradually relaxed as the unfamiliar patterns started to feel more natural. By the end of the week, driving no longer felt strange at all. Yasir realized that most fears about doing something unfamiliar fade quickly once a person simply commits to trying it.
